eval.title: If Disney Pushes Margins Back To 18% It Can Really Boom!

call.headline_quote: at the current price the lower you buy it of course it's better for now it looks like a good business at an okay price

reasons.claim: If Disney becomes the ecosystem winner in streaming thanks to its other businesses and brands, it deserves Morningstar's much higher fair value.
reasons.quote: if that is disney that has the power from the other businesses and the brands to be a winner then it will be the morningstar 170 rating

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: morningstar fair value

reasons.claim: Direct-to-consumer losses are masking much higher underlying operating income, and reaching breakeven there would unlock significant earnings.
reasons.quote: if they just can break even on direct to consumer that would already be great

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: dtc operating loss, operating income

reasons.claim: It is unlikely management will distribute the projected 12 billion in cash flows to shareholders since Disney tends to reinvest, so he halves the present value estimates.
reasons.quote: unlikely that they will reward us directly they always reinvest and all this competition and everything so i would say that let's say we have to cut those in half

data_check.gap_note: he says 1.2e+10, as-of 1.995e+09 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Roughly 50 billion in debt is a concern that prevents Disney from being a totally safe, bargain value investment.
reasons.quote: even if it has 50 billion of that that is unfortunately an issue that doesn't make it a bargain or a value investing where you can be totally safe

reasons.claim: A P/E of around 15 on the 12 billion earnings power is not expensive given the growth still ahead of the business.
reasons.quote: the p e ratio now is around 15 unexpected 12 billion in earnings when they hit it so not that high if we consider the growth ahead

data_check.gap_note: he says 15, as-of 100.294 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

external_facts_used: Morningstar fair value estimate of 65 (70% above current price)
Morningstar's wide economic moat rating for Disney
Morningstar revenue growth projections of 11% for the next four years, slowing 2024-2026
Streaming industry spent $220 billion on content in 2021
Netflix subscriber decline vs Disney subscriber growth of 33% year over year

critic.notes: ok — he calls it fairly valued for a 10% return, 'an okay buy', 'good business at an okay price', tempered by debt and reinvestment concerns; fair_hold fits.
